commonContract.productStorage: one singleton app_settings row: positive checked revision and complete typed SavedSettings JSON document with all five groups and 59 mode/value leaves
commonContract.snapshotRead: coherent resolved saved/default markers, plain admitted effective values, application pendingRestart/failed and exact decimal-string meta.settingsRevision under one publication boundary
commonContract.validation: typed whole-candidate validation with documented integer ranges; JSON numbers may exceed JavaScript exact-integer precision; no silent clamping
commonContract.secretHandling: credentials and generated private keys excluded from settings/status DTOs, error values, public examples and normal structured logs; once-only fresh-key provisioning is an explicit bootstrap handoff
commonContract.privateDiagnosticContract: #280 owns authenticated raw full-fidelity private export including its exact API key/sensitive-value fields and warning/acknowledgement; settings-resource exclusion assigns no export redaction or logger rewrite
commonContract.conditionalWrite: PATCH expectedRevision plus recursively partial typed set and canonical-key reset; one transaction CASes saved revision and checked advancement; no representation-digest CAS
commonContract.omission: unchanged leaf and mode; nullable partial DTO presence is distinct from null
commonContract.null: only nullable leaves accept explicit null; on explicit set, null equal to current default selects default, otherwise custom; an untouched custom null stays custom even if a future release default becomes null
commonContract.reset: mark leaf default and resolve current running default; no historical comparison
commonContract.arrays: replace the complete bounded leaf array
commonContract.application: saved desired values remain authoritative on apply failure; expose effective values, failures and restart-pending fields
commonContract.defaultState: each complete leaf has mode/value; default uses running typed default; untouched custom remains custom even if a new release default equals it; equality classification only on explicit set

savedRepresentation.startup: replace default-marked values in memory from running typed defaults before whole-candidate validation; no old-default comparison and no startup revision advance

patchShape.expectedRevision: required positive decimal string, no leading zero, maximum 9223372036854775807
patchShape.set: optional SettingsPartial of the same five plain-value typed groups
patchShape.reset: optional array of canonical dotted SettingKey values
patchShape.invalid: unknown current key, duplicate reset, set/reset overlap, empty operation including empty nested objects

commonContract.revisionAdvancement: every successful explicit nonempty REST write or offline set/reset advances, even if resulting value/mode is unchanged; startup resolution alone never advances; failed CAS/validation/DB commit changes neither document nor revision; exhaustion never wraps
commonContract.sizeConstraint: saved 128KiB is a whole-candidate serialized UTF-8 limit, not a guarantee every individually valid leaf combination fits; validate before SQL and test escaping/byte boundaries; typed DocumentTooLarge maps HTTP 413; no silent truncation or arbitrary new per-path cap

applicationStatusBounds.truncation: explicit flag; never split UTF-8 code point
applicationStatusBounds.scope: read snapshot contains resolved default-marked saved values, admitted effective values and bounded application status; surface default metadata is separate

commonContract.definitionGeneration: one typed definition source derives value/saved/partial DTOs, metadata and validation; reuse existing nullable helpers, no independent 59-field maps
commonContract.defaultEvolution: review valid custom/default cross-field combinations for future compiled-default changes; no automatic clamping or custom-value discard
commonContract.commitUncertainty: an uncertain worker/commit outcome is explicitly unknown until recovered; never report uncertainty as proven rollback

crossValidation: Validate current typed whole candidate atomically before persistence; no per-field silent coercion.
Configured bind IP/interface must be syntactically valid; membership and current route/interface availability are application-time checks, including offline cross-machine preparation.
network.connections.maxHalfOpenConnections and transfers.maxParallelDownloadPeers do not exceed network.connections.maxConnections; upload.baseSlots does not exceed the connection cap.
Default/custom resolution and admitted effective snapshots preserve the master saved/effective/restart/apply-failure contract.
network.hostnameLookup.enabled requires at least one valid configured resolver; resolver list is bounded and has no silently discarded invalid entries.
network.nat derives local binding and ports from network.p2p. Internal lease/discovery policy retains source defaults 5/3600/300 seconds and renewal margin below lease.
security.vpnGuard.mode=block requires an explicit interface or bind IP, with current runtime fail-closed checks; CIDR list may be empty for interface-only gating.
security.ipFilter.enabled requires a non-null nonempty filePath; validate syntax offline and filesystem availability when applying. Do not silently admit enabled-but-unfiltered state.
Relative paths resolve against profile; no environment/tilde expansion. Apply platform path classes.
Lowering maxConcurrentDownloads drains admissions; do not silently stop current jobs. Built-in discovery-only exploration buffer 2 is not a setting.
